Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.testing.mock

Class MockMatchBuilder.Builder

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.testing.mock.MockMatchBuilder.Builder
Enclosing class:
MockMatchBuilder
public static class MockMatchBuilder.Builder extends Object
Builder for creating customized Match objects with various configuration options.

The builder follows a fluent interface pattern, allowing method chaining for readable match construction. It handles both deterministic and probabilistic match generation based on the provided configuration.

  • Method Details

    • setSearchRegion

      public MockMatchBuilder.Builder setSearchRegion(Region searchRegion)
      Sets the search region within which random matches will be generated.

      When x,y coordinates are not explicitly set, the match will be randomly positioned within this region, ensuring it fits completely inside the boundaries.

      Parameters:
      searchRegion - The region to constrain random match placement. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      This builder instance for method chaining

    • setPattern

      public MockMatchBuilder.Builder setPattern(Pattern pattern)
      Sets the match dimensions based on a Pattern object.

      This method extracts width and height from the pattern to ensure the generated match has the same dimensions as the pattern it supposedly found. Null patterns are safely ignored.

      Parameters:
      pattern - The pattern whose dimensions will be used for the match. Can be null, in which case dimensions remain unchanged.
      Returns:
      This builder instance for method chaining

    • build

      public Match build()
      Builds the Match object based on the configured parameters.

      The build process follows this logic:

      • If x,y coordinates are set (>= 0), creates a fixed-position match
      • Otherwise, creates a randomly positioned match within the search region
      Returns:
      A new Match instance configured according to the builder settings
